description: Validates an operator-supplied three-sheet Utah Business List package and creates a person-free organization-registration projection without network access or national admission.
redirect_policy: No HTTP requests or redirects are permitted.
retry: No automatic retry; replace or correct the operator-supplied package explicitly.
checkpoint: Validation is read-only and returns an in-memory privacy-minimized projection. The retained original workbook is hash-bound but JSONL extraction reproducibility and source authenticity remain unverified; no release or pointer is written.
idempotency: The original workbook SHA-256, three ordered operator-derived sheet SHA-256 values, transformation version, and package selection identify the inspected package.
cancellation: Abort cooperatively between sheets and before projection; no output artifact or pointer exists to clean up.
retention_profile: Operator files remain local; principal, applicant, officer, agent, partner, and free-text information is never emitted by the projection.
